description: Turn a child's first name, or a class list of up to 40, into a 9-page activity book for each child built around their name: a cover, a name coloring page, name tracing, a word search, a maze, a dot-to-dot, a secret code and a word scramble, with the answers on the last page. Returns a PDF link.

level.description: easy, challenge or expert puzzles in the book. Defaults to easy.

names.description: One first name or up to 40: an array, or one string separated by commas or new lines. Up to 12 letters. Accents, hyphens and apostrophes print as typed.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

theme.description: The pictures around the name: animals (Animals), ocean (Ocean), space (Space), vehicles (Vehicles), treats (Sweet treats), nature (Nature), halloween (Halloween), thanksgiving (Thanksgiving), christmas (Christmas), new-years (New Year's), valentines-day (Valentine's Day). Defaults to animals.

name: make_name_book
title: Make a personalized name activity book
